caption: The drawing depicts a rounded, grey ceramic pot with two curved handles on either side. The handles are decorated with blue stripes and attached near the rim, which has a flared, outwardly projecting lip. The body of the pot features blue floral and leaf motifs, with a main flower and foliage design centered on the pot's front. Blue decorative lines encircle the neck and base of the pot. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is an inset detail showing one handle in close-up, which highlights its form and the blue decorative accents. The background is plain and off-white, and the composition is enclosed within a rectangular border.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
